objective: Align the two trade-intent schemas without canonicalizing the wrong episode definition. PART 1 (identity): make the EPISODE scope of FM-027 displacement_retrace and FM-028 displacement_atr_ratio an explicit, machine-readable ontology contract, record their distinctness from FM-021 retest_depth / FM-020 disp_strength on both nodes, and correct their stale source_of_truth citations. Additive lineage/semantics blocks only (unread by any runtime path per spec_schema.additive_spec_blocks); no FM id minted, no formula identity changed, no CANONICAL_FEATURES change. PART 2 (classifier): split ExecutionPlannerV1_2._derive_intent's EMA test into its two halves, adding CONTINUATION for with-trend entries so they stop falling through to UNKNOWN (measured 40.70% LONG / 31.97% SHORT of the XAUUSD M15 corpus) and being rejected by reject_unknown_intent. reject_unknown_intent stays True.
change_class_rationale: FEATURE_IDENTITY_CHANGE: FM-027/FM-028 refine IN PLACE (ids kept, version bumped) with an explicit scope contract -- a refinement of a governed identity's declared contract, not a rename or retirement. RUNTIME_DECISION_PATH_CHANGE: the planner's intent classification changes on the live rail (with-trend entries relabelled UNKNOWN -> CONTINUATION, so they are no longer rejected). PRODUCTION_CONFIG_CHANGE: execution_planner.ttl_continuation_sec is added to configs/production/v2_htfcrt_2026_08.json, strictly required. DATASET_SCHEMA_CHANGE was considered and deliberately NOT declared: CANONICAL_FEATURES, SCHEMA_HASH and FEATURE_ORDER_HASH are untouched. MODEL_INPUT_CHANGE was NOT declared: no model reads planner intent.

problem_addressed.schema_mismatch: Arm A (CRT cache, episode-scoped) and Arm C (canonical row, bar-scoped) share no quantity -- only names. FM-027 is retrace into the displacement body; FM-021 is |close-ema_fast|/atr_abs masked to 0.0 unless retest_flag==1. FM-028 is candle_range/atr_abs of the displacement candle; FM-020 is body_size/atr_abs of the current bar.
problem_addressed.why_not_a_vector_slot: feature_pipeline.py contains zero occurrences of disp_open/disp_close/displacement_candle. FM-027 needs a pairing of one displacement candle with one retest candle, which exists only in the CRT state machine. A vector slot would need either a second state machine in the pipeline (whose retest definition already disagrees with the engine: retest_flag==1 on 58.07% of bars yet 0 on 4 of 6 engine RETEST bars) or a sentinel on the ~99% of bars with no episode.
problem_addressed.unknown_hole: _derive_intent's REVERSAL is strictly counter-trend, so a with-trend entry that is not a sweep/pullback/breakout falls to UNKNOWN and is rejected. Traced instance: 2024-08-21 22:15 LONG, ema_fast 2512.907 > ema_slow 2510.742.
